audit_harness_change.description: Workbook-only and auxiliary-only do not create three unrelated Sheet fixtures; accessibility and all data/Undo assertions remain enabled.
audit_harness_change.initial_probe: Interrupted during initialization before any key sample; retained as an anomaly, not a pass.
audit_harness_change.scope_limit: Clean Workbook/Writer samples are single-window workloads and not directly comparable with historical samples that kept three unrelated 100k Sheet views open.
audit_harness_change.production_risk: Native initialization with multiple extra huge tables remains a separate unaccepted scenario; removing benchmark contamination does not prove that scenario fixed.

current_audit_code_change: One-line Matplotlib paginated Bias percent panel tuple fix; incoming export changes reviewed and checkpointed together.
limits: No all-table millisecond acceptance: full Workbook and Writer Undo remain slow.
Three fresh views in one process for each sheet version; not three fresh application processes.
CPU-heavy validation jobs ran serially. OS/background load is not controlled.
Small-sample P95 is the maximum, not a confidence bound.
Qt paint completion, not DWM FPS; dispatch is distinct from complete refresh.
Fixture construction is outside operation timings; millisecond Ctrl+A does not imply millisecond document opening.
RSS/private are end snapshots; peak is cumulative per process including setup.
Sync mixed fixture has two Correlation, two undrawn Map and one empty independent Dynamic; not five fully drawn tools.
Historical Task07/08 comparisons predate this audit. Current audit did not optimize their production code.
Presentation changes and All Dies removal documented in prior work mean full v4.2.0 UI/pixel parity is not claimed.
No long-duration leak/soak test or packaged EXE validation.
